text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Stay 
Gold— We decided to drop by a café I had 
looked up in advance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...So that she can enjoy herself, even 
just a little."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
You ordered with practiced ease. Do you 
come here often?
choice_data_list: Well yeah, I really recommend this place.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I explain how the menus change seasonally 
for lunch and dinner, going into detail 
about what dishes we've had so far.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Huh. Then how about we come back around 
lunchâwait, whoa?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rustle)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
What's going on here? ...Travel brochures? 
That's a lot. Looks like they're all for 
places nearby, though.
choice_data_list: I just happened to see it...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Oh. This place brings back memories. I 
came here before. There was a 
hundred-year-old building, wasn't there?
choice_data_list:
If we're going, somewhere we've never been 
before would be nice, right?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
When traveling, you should go wherever 
your heart desires. It's not an 
obligation, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Actually, it wasn't just the cafe. I 
also searched for and gathered these 
pamphlets just for her."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haha. If it weren't fun, I wouldn't be 
here in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even without going on a long journey—so 
that they can enjoy themselves right here. 
...So that they don't feel cooped up, you 
see.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Oho. Now this is quite a sight. Flowers, 
flowers everywhere. Every view and scent, 
completely filled with blossoms.
choice_data_list: Seasonal flowers bloom here as well.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. Well, that's great. It's my 
first time here, so everything feels so 
fresh and new.
choice_data_list: I see, so it's your first time!
I see, it's your first time, huh!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, it's my first time.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
The sun has completely set, huh. Well, I'm 
used to the view from here, but what kind 
of fresh perspective are you going to show 
me?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Stay Gold smiled meaningfully. Her eyes 
seemed to be reading my true intentions... 
Could it be?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
You were wondering about it on the rooftop 
before, weren't you? Whether I'm having 
fun right now.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Pfft! Hahaha! You're definitely the type 
who can't keep secrets, aren't you~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Stay Gold says nothing more. She doesn't 
ask any questions either. She just basks 
in the gentle breeze, waiting for my 
response.
choice_data_list:
...I was worried you might be feeling 
cooped up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And I confessed that I had secretly 
suspected... that the cause of all this 
might be our Trainer contract."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: What a bizarre thing to think about.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Stay Gold declares nonchalantly.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I'm here of my own free will, and nothing 
else. You know that too, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Because you're the one who said it. That 
you'd choose 'an unknown voyage with an 
unseen path where storms await.'"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"That is my journey as well. You climbed 
aboard it. ...No, you said we'd share it 
together."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Is that not so?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
So, you think I'm the type of person who'd 
just up and abandon a companion on my 
journey?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...Who knows? I'm a whimsical person, 
after all. I might just carelessly leave 
you behind."
choice_data_list:
W-When that time comes, I'll chase after 
you...!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Figures. That's just the kind of 
person you are.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...And? So, who is bound here, and how, 
exactly?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hey. —My travel companion?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I found myself easily convinced by her 
words. —After all, who on earth could ever 
hope to tie down Stay Gold?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Realizing that my worries were nothing 
more than self-conscious overthinking, I 
felt like burying my head in my hands. As 
I involuntarily looked down..."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Are you relieved?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Startled by Stay Gold peering at me from 
right up close, I let out a yelp.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, you're way too surprised. Still... 
if you're still uneasy, how about 
something like this?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Because you are here, I can be here.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"If you look at it that way, wouldn't it 
take some of the pressure off?"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From her tone of voice, I could tell she 
was half teasing me.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haha! That sounds great. Still, the 
brochure... that short trip idea wasn't 
bad. You're coming too, right? With me.
choice_data_list: I'll go grab some more pamphlets.
Let's go do what you want to do, Stay Gold

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"There were quite a lot of them, though. 
If you're going to collect even more, 
first we'll have to go on a journey just 
gathering pamphlets."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"I have no experience with a journey like 
that. ...I wonder what it'll be like, 
aren't you looking forward to it, 
Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
What I wanna do, huh... If it's how I feel 
right now, maybe skydiving, or bungee 
jumping?
choice_data_list: Are you going to... combine those...?
Are you going to... combine those...?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. Don't worry, I won't leave you 
behind. You're my traveling partner, after 
all... right?♪

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Wouldn't doing that just turn it 
into a cookie-cutter trip? Feels like a 
waste, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
A rough plan is fine. Moods change faster 
than the weather, after all.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's just a little journey, let's 
enjoy an adventure into the unknown, shall 
we?
